scope: Authoritative source tracing for rarity, factions, CV, origin, artwork and skins without inferred display values.

canonicalIdentity.reuseRule: Do not rebuild playable-Hero identity in Stage 5-5-2.

rarity.rule: Star/Rank values may be measured but must not be converted to rarity labels until their semantics are independently validated.

factions.rule: Do not synthesize factions from jobs, aura eligibility, story affiliation or existing display text without a validated upstream source.

cv.rule: Numeric voice/resource identifiers, when present, are not actor/CV display names without a validated name mapping.

origin.rule: Measure pointer coverage only. Do not map production IDs to work titles until an authoritative dictionary is validated.

artwork.rule: Measure pointer coverage only. CharImage_ID is not yet promoted to final Hero-detail portrait/artwork semantics.

skins.rule: Membership and ID resolution may be validated now; display ordering and GetPathType meaning remain unresolved until separately proven.

nonSynthesisPolicy: Unresolved fields stay null/review. Candidate field names and numeric values are not sufficient to create page-display values.
nextGate: Run the coverage generator and review missing HeroInfo rows, origin/artwork pointer coverage, skin orphan IDs and SpecifiedHero mismatches before promoting any additional field.
